title: Amicable Lattice Rhombuses are Amicable
summary: A polygon is equable if its area is equal to its perimeter. A pair of polygons is an amicable pair if the area of the first is equal to the perimeter of the second, and vice versa. A polygon is a lattice polygon if its vertices lie on the integer lattice. We show that amicable lattice rhombuses are actually equable.
